sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emily.
I am happy you are here.
Today we will talk about San Marino.
San Marino is a small, old and peaceful country in Europe.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Are you ready?
Let's begin.
Where is San Marino?
San Marino is in southern Europe.
It is a tiny country inside Italy.
It has no sea, but it is near the Adriatic coast.
San Marino is on a hill with beautiful views
of the land below.
What is the capital city of San Marino?
The capital is also called San Marino.
It is an old town with stone streets, towers and castles.
The city sits on top of Mount Titano.
Other small towns in the country include Borgo Magiora Saravale.
But all of San Marino is very small.
You can drive across it in about 30 minutes.
How many people live in San Marino?
Only about 34,000 people live in San Marino.
It is one of the smallest countries in the world.
Most people live in villages and small towns.
What language do people speak in San Marino?
People speak Italian.
Some people also speak English, especially in tourist areas.
The local culture is very close to Italian culture.
What is the weather like in San Marino?
San Marino has a Mediterranean climate.
Warm, dry summers, cool, rainy winters.
In winter, there may be a little snow in the hills.
In summer, the days are sunny and hot.
What does San Marino look like?
San Marino has hills and cliffs.
The tall Mount Titano, castles, walls and towers,
green fields and views of Italy.
The most famous sites are the three towers of San Marino.
Old stone towers on top of the mountain.
What animals live in San Marino?
San Marino is small, so there are not many wild animals,
but you can find birds, lizards and squirrels,
rabbits, foxes and insects, cats and dogs and homes.
The countryside is quiet and clean.
What do people eat in San Marino?
Food in San Marino is very similar to Italian food.
People eat pasta, cheese and bread.
Tomatoes, olive oil and garlic.
Meat, fish and vegetables.
Popular dishes, torta tres monti,
a sweet cake with chocolate and cream.
Pasta with meat sauce, grilled meat,
fresh salads with local cheese.
Meals are often simple, fresh and homemade.
What do people drink in San Marino?
People drink water, coffee and tea, fruit juice.
Adults may drink local wine, beer or a special liqueur from San Marino.
Coffee is very popular, usually small and strong like in Italy.
What is life like in San Marino?
Life is peaceful, quiet and safe.
People enjoy spending time with family,
working in shops or tourism, walking in nature,
drinking coffee with friends, watching sports,
especially football.
Many people work in small businesses or government jobs.
What are some holidays and traditions?
National Day, September 3,
Feast of St. Marriness, the country's founder,
Christmas and Easter,
medieval festivals with costumes, music and flags.
Republic Day, March 25,
people wear traditional clothes during parades and celebrations.
Some fun facts about San Marino.
San Marino is the oldest republic in the world,
founded in the year 301.
It has no army, only a small police force.
It has two captains, called Capitani Regente,
who lead the country together.
San Marino prints its own stamps and coins.
The flag is white and blue with a crown and three towers.
Now you know many things about San Marino.
You know where it is, what people eat and how they live.
You learned about the hills, the towers and the traditions.
Well done.
I am Emily.
Goodbye.
Or Natalyan Ardi Viberci.
